'''Spectral tenders''' are found in the south-east room of the ruined temple under [[Soul Wars]], during the [[Nomad's Requiem]] quest. They tend the Strange device by putting fuel into it.

A [[Salve amulet]] or [[Salve amulet (e)]] is effective when killing Spectral worshippers.
